name: app-banking-results-slide-with-dot-charts
title: Banking Results Slide with Dot Charts
whatItIs: A light grey results slide with a large title, three pill-shaped feedback statements with avatars, and three small cards: a dotted bar chart, a semicircle gauge (86%) and a line-bar chart (98%).
whatItMeans: Tiny dot and line chart textures make numbers feel crafted, and pill quotes keep human voices present.
techniques: Dotted-matrix bars for a tactile data texture
Dark pill labels floating above chart peaks
Cards placed at staggered heights bottom right
Large empty space around a small cluster of content

vocabulary.definition: A chart built from small dots instead of solid bars.
A rounded strip holding a user statement and avatar.
A small label pinned to the peak of a chart.
